posts.name: OddballPaladin
posts.cooked:
There are three types of tanks (in my view, but I have… thoughts on the tank as a classification…), depending on how they deal with incoming damage: Redirection, Mitigation, and Regeneration. EE Glamor is a great example of a deflection tank. Mitigation tanks are normal Legacy, Scholar, and the like. Boldest Legacy looks to be the first Regeneration tank I’ve seen in a while, where he both reduces damage (normal Legacy stuff), and this new power of self-healing.

Scholar… is probably going to be a mix of mitigation and deflection. He’s probably going to have a LOT of reactions, and a lot of area stuff. Maybe even some ongoing that lets him use his reactions when others take damage…

Gonna have to be honest, I think the ship sailed on these forums or the Reddit ever being lively again. Speaking of, is anyone attending and will GTG have some version of Disparation for the public to try there? The rest of us are starving for more content. Help us, Christopher Badell! You’re our only hope.

I don’t think Christopher will answer—if nothing else, he’s already at GenCon now, setting up and doing pre-event-events, and will not be reading the forums. It’s not like Defenders of the Realm and Compile, where a lot of effort went into making playable, presentable prototypes. That’s what I was afraid of, that another month would go by without any significant reveal. Everyone got excited when they whetted our appetites right around the crowdfunding campaign, but seems like they definitely jumped the gun when it comes to estimated product completion. Some of that could not be helped, I know. Glad to hear it sounds like they’ve learned from that now.

Anyway, looking forward to seeing what does come out of GenCon as far as TLP goes. Those episodes are always different and interesting.

posts.name: Chief Lackey Rich

Sure we do. They owe RPG backers four hardcover books - the History of Sentinels Comics book, which is supposedly going to be pretty big and has no actual game content, the Diamond Book of Monsters, which should be about the same size as the Guise Book, a somewhat larger Darkwatch sourcebook, and a larger-still Urban Settings sourcebook. All of these were originally due by 2020, but of course COVID happened. All are currently projected for 2025 release dates.

There’s also the Sentinel Choices zine/game, which is its own system and got added to backer rewards following 2019 KS Zine Quest event - and which was most recently due to release in December 2024.

Dammit, no back cover to tease the next expansion. Also no alt-reality critical events for the core game villains which is kind of a shame.

We got Rambler’s nemesis icon. Can also see Abbados is Nightmist’s nemesis and Greezigrax is Rambler’s.

Ok, so if Iron Legacy is still just an 8 difficulty of the 1-10 scale, what villains will possibly be a 9 or 10. Just Progeny?

Wow, Principle of the Undead seems very cool, especially for Unity or Captain Cosmic since their minions can still act in their brief absence. Not sure what happens to your hand though. Can you still draw/discard cards while dead? Also Zombie KNYFE writer’s room when?

Wonder how hard it would be to use Dark Visionary’s power to get all 10 Dark Side cards in your hand, ensuring they can’t be played randomly by your main cards.

Fingers crossed for no more delays. Critical Multiplier and Principle of Magic seem extremely interesting from what’s in the FAQ.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Dil_Ninja:

Not sure what happens to your hand though. Can you still draw/discard cards while dead?

You follow the rules as written: Your hand doesn’t change because nothing says it does. You can’t draw cards because the incap rules say you can’t. You can discard them, though.
